headline: Applied Sciences, Vol. 16, Pages 10017: A Linkable Anonymous and Verifiable Sealed-Bid Auction Scheme for Consortium Blockchain
summary: This paper proposes LAV-Auction, a linkable anonymous and verifiable sealed-bid auction scheme for consortium blockchain. Each bidder submits a commitment, a bid ciphertext containing the bid value and commitment randomness, and an auction-scoped linkable ring signature. LAV-Auction provides bidder anonymity, bid confidentiality before committee decryption, duplicate bid prevention, and verifiable winner correctness over the frozen valid bid set.
